About this item

  • EXCLUSIVE RECTANGULAR DESIGN – The classic rectangle sunglasses keep up with the latest fashion trends, and follow the 90s retro sunglasses style. Unique metal detailing on the temples adds gorgeous flair to your everyday outfits for daily occasions. So they are the must-have accessory for your wardrobe.
  • UV400 TAC POLARIZED LENSES – SOJOS' high-definition TAC polarized lenses can filter out sunlight reflected glare and protect your eyes from long-term damage by blocking 99.99% of harmful UVA and UVB rays.
  • PERFECT ALL-ROUNDER – These SOJOS rectangle sunglasses for women and men polarized are the perfect choice for outdoor activities such as shopping, driving, traveling and taking selfies. They are also suitable as high-fashion accessories and for daily wear all year round.
  • PRODUCT DIMENSIONS – Lens Width: 55mm(2.17inches) | Lens Height: 34mm(1.34inches) | Temple Length: 140mm(5.51inches) | Nose Bridge: 18mm(0.71inches).
  • GIFT IDEAS PACKAGE – Sunglasses*1, microfiber pouch*1, microfiber glasses cleaning cloth*1, glasses box*1. It comes with gift-ready packaging, making it a wonderful yet practical gift idea for friends and family!

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sunglasses to be of good quality, offering great value for money and excellent sun protection, with one customer noting how the polarized lenses cut down glare from water and sand. They appreciate the polarization feature, lightweight design, and perfect color, with one mentioning they don't slip down even with sunscreen and sweat. The durability receives mixed feedback - while some find them durable, others report that the hinges snap from normal wear and tear.

5 out of 5 stars
Very “summer at the Hamptons” without the Hamptons price tag.
These are perfect for sunny beach days! The polarized lenses cut down so much of the glare from the water and sand that I could actually enjoy looking around instead of squinting. They’re also really flattering, fit perfectly/very comfortable to wear all day and have a classic style that feels timeless. Very chic, very effortless, very “don’t bother me, I’m on vacation.” Not only do they instantly make even a basic outfit look more polished and expensive but they also feel expensive. Very sturdy and don’t feel like they snap easily. 10/10 worth every penny!

    The brown frames and lenses are even prettier in person and give them such a classic, slightly elevated look without feeling too dressy. They also feel comfortable to wear and I love that the frame isn’t overly bulky on the face.

About this Item

  • EXCLUSIVE RECTANGULAR DESIGN – The classic rectangle sunglasses keep up with the latest fashion trends, and follow the 90s retro sunglasses style. Unique metal detailing on the temples adds gorgeous flair to your everyday outfits for daily occasions. So they are the must-have accessory for your wardrobe.
  • UV400 TAC POLARIZED LENSES – SOJOS' high-definition TAC polarized lenses can filter out sunlight reflected glare and protect your eyes from long-term damage by blocking 99.99% of harmful UVA and UVB rays.
  • PERFECT ALL-ROUNDER – These SOJOS rectangle sunglasses for women and men polarized are the perfect choice for outdoor activities such as shopping, driving, traveling and taking selfies. They are also suitable as high-fashion accessories and for daily wear all year round.
  • PRODUCT DIMENSIONS – Lens Width: 55mm(2.17inches) | Lens Height: 34mm(1.34inches) | Temple Length: 140mm(5.51inches) | Nose Bridge: 18mm(0.71inches).
  • GIFT IDEAS PACKAGE – Sunglasses*1, microfiber pouch*1, microfiber glasses cleaning cloth*1, glasses box*1. It comes with gift-ready packaging, making it a wonderful yet practical gift idea for friends and family!
